d:
Shaggy, platinum white hair with long, messy bangs covering the forehead. Pale violet, narrow almond-shaped eyes with a mischievous expression. Appears as a mature adolescent with a slender, lithe build. Wears a white and gold oversized hoodie with a matching white cloak and gold trim. Features a pair of small, white demonic horns protruding from the head and a long, thin, white demonic tail.
BODY COLOR: pale white
